mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO rise > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between HOUST and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent labor market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO fall > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction, especially in late-cycle regimes.
